title: Primefold PageSpec
description: A page composition: one template, one route, a mode and an ordered node list. Draft-07; closed enums; additionalProperties:false everywhere. mode 'clone' = faithful Primefold reconstruction (Primefold-owned assets may be reused); mode 'generation' = a page for another brand (no Primefold identity, assets, copy, people, customers or URLs; enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py GENERATION_MODE_* rules). x-maxWords / x-placeholderOnly are enforced by the semantic validator. GENERATED by extraction/build_schema.py from the contracts - do not hand-edit.

mode.description: clone: faithful reconstruction of the Primefold source. generation: a new page for another brand.

theme.description: Theme the styleTokens resolve against (tokens/themes). Defaults to the manifest defaultTheme.

brand.description: Generation mode: the brand the page is FOR (fictional or user-supplied). Must not be a Primefold name.

styleTokens.description: Optional per-node style-token slots. Values are token PATHS from tokens/llm/token-catalog.json; which category each slot accepts, raw-value bans and theme combinations are enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py (TOKEN_* rules).
